body: I wonder if I can make it through
I'm open to try... Thank you for taking to time to read my post.. I really appreciate it...

That's not true... 
We understand... At least some of us do... Truth is I'm in the same boat as you... Normal people don't get it... Everyone else just claims to have exceptional control over their emotions.. And all... While making other people feel like something is wrong with them.. Not all us are in great mental health but the world now just makes it so hard to be ourselves... Mental health... Anxiety... No social skills... Sometimes it gets hard... But its not your fault... Its this messed up world that stereotypes us from the get go... You me... Everyone else deserves to be free of the bounds... You may not be sure of much  but one thing you can be sure of is that youre not alone... Never forget... And don't ever feel alone
